name: Trazodone
effects: Reduces depressive symptoms; widely used at low doses (25–100 mg) as a non-habit-forming hypnotic
SARI: inhibits SERT + potently antagonizes 5-HT2A — antidepressant without full agonism risk
Sedation (alpha-1 and H1 blockade) — helpful for comorbid insomnia in depression
Priapism risk (rare but serious — requires emergency intervention)
Minimal anticholinergic and sexual dysfunction effects
Risk of serotonin syndrome at high doses or in combination
